searched.title: Bambu Lab US store product page: Bambu High Flow Hotend - H2/P2S/X2D
searched.note: The P0 corpus copy, parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload, manifest row). Its Product Specifications table gives Max. Printing Temp. 350 ℃, Length 49.2 mm, Packaging Weight 0.028 kg and Packaging Size 60*60*30mm (all kept by the deterministic layer); it has no In the Box section, no width, height or net weight, no filament diameter (the 1.75 mm rows in the page data belong to the printers and AMS units it embeds) and no electrical value. Its description carries the volumetric-flow comparison, the Printer Compatability table and the Filament Compatibility table used here.

searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). The "H2 Series/P2S/X2D Nozzle" panel (purchase links "Bambu Hotend - H2/P2S Standard & High Flow") and the compatibility row "H2 Series/P2S High Flow Hotend" name this product. The panel's "Size: 0.2mm/ 0.4mm/ 0.6mm/ 0.8mm" and "Materials: Hardened steel / Stainless steel" cover the standard and high-flow hotends together; the store page sells this one as 0.4/0.6/0.8 mm hardened steel only, so the per-option diameter and material stay with the store page's option values (official_variant). Its "62.5%" higher maximum volume velocity and "up to 30%" time saving are marketing prose and give no value. It states no dimensions, weight, filament diameter, In the Box list or electrical value for this product. The 300°C rating of the "H2 Series Hotend Silicone Sock" belongs to that separate product.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: A general guide for every Bambu nozzle. Its Nozzle table has "0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 mm High flow nozzle" columns, compared cell by cell with the store page's Filament Compatibility table: they agree except PET-CF/GF, PPA-CF/GF and PPS-CF/GF at 0.4 mm ("Not Recommended" on the wiki, "√(Only for Left Hotend)" on the store; see those relations' conflict notes). Its nozzle temperatures are per filament, not values of this product, and none of its rows is stored as a spec here. It gives no filament diameter.
